QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Simia, the Kitchen Hand
QuestInfo.0: You followed the delicious aroma to a dark and remote place behind the village. There you met Simia and the three chick siblings who live with her.
QuestInfo.1: You followed the delicious aroma to a dark and remote place behind the village. There you met Simia and the three chick siblings who live with her.
QuestInfo.2: You followed the delicious aroma to a dark and remote place behind the village. There you met Simia and the three chick siblings who live with her. Her unique tastes mean she might be the only chef who can make something Muto will eat. That means you need her help!
